csvUrl.title: CSV File URL
csvUrl.description: Public URL of the Skool CSV export (Apify Key-Value Store URL or any public link). Leave empty if using csvContent.

csvContent.title: CSV Content (paste directly)
csvContent.description: Paste raw CSV content here if you don't have a URL.

groupSlugs.title: Group slugs (override — optional)
groupSlugs.description: If set, only these slugs are validated (ignores CSV). Useful for spot-checking.

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Polite crawl delay in milliseconds. Default 1500.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages to fetch in parallel. Keep low (1-3) to avoid rate-limiting.

maxGroups.title: Max groups (0 = all)
maxGroups.description: Limit number of groups processed. 0 means process all. Useful for testing.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy config. Recommended: use Apify residential proxies if you hit rate limits.

notifyOnPriceChange.title: Notify on price change
notifyOnPriceChange.description: If true, actor will emit a warning log entry for every group whose price changed.
